about: issues.md item 3: C2SaferRust mutation kills (harness/mutate_full.py, results/cli_mutation_full.json) re-scanned so that a mutant counts as killed only on a case where the C is UB-clean under the rule of results/oracle_ub_c2saferrust.json. runs.rust = the C2Rust starting translation (the harness_power row); runs.rust_WIP = C2SaferRust's own output (reported separately). Each run carries its own provenance (harness/arxiv_mutate_full_ubfilter.py, driver harness/arxiv_mutub_run.sh c2sr <variant>).

rust.killed_if_null_plus_zero_alone_is_not_ub: every original first-kill case that is UB only through clang's NULL+0 report is UB-clean under this view, so those kills stand; computed from the records, no re-run

rust_WIP.killed_if_null_plus_zero_alone_is_not_ub: every original first-kill case that is UB only through clang's NULL+0 report is UB-clean under this view, so those kills stand; computed from the records, no re-run

provenance.git_note: study repo working tree (Mac) at that commit plus uncommitted files, this script new; rsynced to the run host without .git
provenance.mutant_source: mutants[] of the results file (sites and first-kill cases as recorded); trees, vendored libc and baseline_<util>.json copied from the original run's work dir

rust.rule:
harness/mutate_full.py (results/cli_mutation_full.json) runs a mutant over the v4 grid in grid order
and stops at the FIRST case whose stdout/exit differs from the C (_run_mutant). It does not ask
whether the C is UB-clean on that case. The defect count does: a case counts only if the C passes
the full UB rule (results/oracle_ub_c2saferrust.json: clang-14 and gcc-11 ASan+UBSan+
float-cast-overflow, gcc -O1/-O2 == -O0, -funsigned-char/-fsigned-char == ref, and every run
completed and agreed). This script applies the same rule to the mutation kills:

summary.killed_if_null_plus_zero_alone_is_not_ub: every original first-kill case that is UB only through clang's NULL+0 report is UB-clean under this view, so those kills stand; computed from the records, no re-run
